Complete memory layouts of floating marker and configuration table structures.

findings.text: Init code outside this file can trigger floating marker discovery, early controller mapping, full topology parsing and reservation of a relocated table area through four globally visible routines.
Discovery starts by scanning low memory, upper base memory, firmware space and the extended BIOS area for a validated floating marker and remembering its address for later steps.
Early parsing only establishes the local controller address while late parsing builds processors buses controllers and interrupt routing, with ACPI supplied data suppressing overlapping legacy work.
Per processor register access is offered through open read write and control entry points where the minor number chooses the processor and the file offset chooses the register.

A configuration table is trusted only when its marker matches, its checksum over its stated length passes, its version is one of two supported values and its controller address is nonzero, with short fixed length identity strings recorded.

A nonzero default identifier selects synthetic topology construction and skips memory table parsing, while a zero identifier with a valid pointer selects table parsing and a zero identifier without a pointer is treated as unreachable.
Table entries are consumed sequentially by type with a shared byte offset advanced by the size that belongs to the observed kind, stopping at the stated table length or on an unknown type.

Only level sensitive active low interrupt inputs are considered for replacement, matched on bus and source line against already stored entries with claimed entries marked to detect duplicates and the rest deferred to a bounded spare collection.
Register reads and writes proceed in whole register units and fail sizing checks otherwise, returning partial byte counts when some units succeed before an access or copy fault.

Writes follow a three state policy with unconditional allow, unconditional deny and a default that allows while emitting a rate limited warning, always combined with a lockdown check and a permanent out of specification mark on success paths.
Setup moves from scan and reserve to early mapping to full construction, with an optional late phase that rewrites interrupt entries and refreshes integrity values.

Rewriting stays dormant unless an enable flag is set, then chooses in place modification after a writability probe or relocation to a reserved area with marker redirection, followed by entry replacement and checksum renewal.

Unknown entry types abort parsing with a diagnostic dump, absent processors or absent interrupt entries raise firmware bug reports with fallback defaults or disabled symmetric support, and undersized relocation areas force fallback or warnings.

Edge level information from compatibility hardware is accepted only when historic timer keyboard cascade and coprocessor lines all report edge behavior, otherwise the fallback is abandoned to avoid misprogramming.

Opening fails for callers without raw input output privilege, for out of range or offline processors, or for processors without the register feature, while control operations enforce read or write mode and reject unknown requests.

Observed configuration kinds include processor bus controller interrupt source and local source records, each introduced by a type tag and carrying identifiers addresses flags and routing fields used during topology build.
The floating marker carries specification version, length, checksum, feature indicators and an optional table pointer, with one feature bit selecting between compatibility modes on some builds.

Scan windows are address zero length 1024, address 654336 length 1024, address 983040 length 65536, and extended BIOS length 1024 when present, stepping 16 with marker size 16 and required length one and version one or four.

Default topology uses two processors with identifiers zero and one, one controller with identifier two, bus zero always and bus one for higher numbered defaults, sixteen interrupt lines with line zero routed to input two and one extra external interrupt from line zero to input zero, skipping line two always and lines zero and thirteen for one default.

Supported table versions are one and four, signature comparison covers four bytes, identity fields hold eight and twelve characters plus terminators, spare interrupt slots total twenty, relocated table default length is 4096 with alignment four, and stolen marker space is sixteen bytes below 1024.
Each register transfer moves eight bytes, control operations exchange eight 32 bit values, and write warnings are limited to one message per thirty seconds.
Message formatting uses the module name as a prefix and a static variable retains the processor hotplug state for the register driver.
Two symbols have empty variants that perform no work, used when the corresponding feature is disabled at build time.
Global state records whether a floating marker was found and its physical address, gating all later parsing and update steps.
